summary: Context-only committee read: the measured tape remains RISK_ON, but the confirmed US Q2 reflation label is internally unsupported by current axes, which read Q3-like (growth -0.33, inflation +0.68) and are 5 of 7 sessions into confirmation. This is a transition watch, not a position or forecast. The risk radar is WATCH because its growth-scare component is rising, yet its own measured 21-session pullback frequency is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate (0.73x), so it does not establish a downside edge. Credit remains tight, volatility calm, breadth above the 200-day average near 65%, and the recession indicator is off. Liquidity is neutral-hollow: RRP is exhausted, but no confirming funding or credit stress is present. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no surviving scorecard legs, and the displayed low-beta leader has negative IC. The graded spine extract is dominated by repeated Canadian-board rows and unsigned-MFE outcomes; it is unsuitable for inferring directional skill or broad family reliability. Kernel results reinforce restraint: no reviewed engine is armed; radar, policy, stock-desk, thematic-desk, and alt-data signed-excess profiles are negative over several relevant horizons, while apparently positive board and track-record results use unsigned-MFE proxies or vacuous allocation tests. No new hypothesis was staked because the available evidence did not support a sufficiently clean, non-originating pre-registered test within the weekly budget.
